restaurant_name: คลินิก รพ.สมเด็จพระนางเจ้าสิริกิติ์ สาขานาจอมเทียน
text: Terrible experience. I took my boyfriend to the doctor because he was sick and coughing. While we were waiting, an elderly woman (this has happened several times before) spoke to patients with terrible manners. She said, "If you're coughing, you have to sit outside!" But he was in a hot place; couldn't he just wait inside for a little while? I've heard her speak like this many times on my visits. Is she even a nurse, or just someone helping out? We're already paying more for social security benefits, which means we're paying you too! If caring for sick patients is so difficult for you, then stay home! Don't make younger people like us have to yell at you! And when she checked his temperature, she spoke as if he was begging to be examined because he was coughing. Please understand the nature of your work! What exactly is your job?! 🤬😡 And why wouldn't she let us see the doctor after asking questions? Did she think we were pretending to be there? This hasn't happened just once or twice, it's happened many times. What kind of behavior is this? It's awful, awful, awful!
author_name: สารืณี มานัสฤดี

restaurant_name: คลินิก รพ.สมเด็จพระนางเจ้าสิริกิติ์ สาขานาจอมเทียน
text:
Every time I see an elderly female doctor with short hair (I have her name, but I don't want to specify)
she always prescribes the wrong medication. She says I have a cold and sore throat, but doesn't examine my throat and only gives me decongestants.
She doesn't have throat medication, so I have to buy it myself. The doctor is constantly on her phone, glued to her phone, watching vertical Chinese dramas.
How can someone like this be a doctor? She's so addicted to her phone! Usually, I see a male doctor who is excellent. Every time I see this female doctor, it's terrible. I pay 875 baht a month through social security, but the medication I receive isn't worth it. I'm avoiding seeing this female doctor next time. She's awful.
